name: Gucker
description: The Winterworks Gucker: a big salamander-like End predator in vanilla style: long, low and heavy on splayed legs with broad flat feet, a wide flat head with a toothy underbite and flat glowing yellow eyes on two domes, an inflatable throat sac, a ridge of glowing breathing holes along the back, a thick finned tail; pale grey-violet hide with saddle blotches that blends with end stone. Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
